person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating third-person narrator. Multiple interior Goodreads passages externally narrate Annie and other characters, and q02879 displays omniscient knowledge of causal alternatives unknown to them. The authorized opening independently sustains the same external narration, while three explicit whole-book sources identify third-person or third-person omniscient narration. First-person and second-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue or general aphorisms, not autonomous base sections. The only limitation is that the Tier A prose covers the opening rather than every section, but the interior quotes and whole-book descriptions consistently corroborate it with no credible contrary evidence.
